note: Loose keyword intents learned from how real people phrase requests (SLURP devel split). All are 'fallback': tried only after every specific phrase, and 'unless' words veto them. {all} is the whole request as said.

commands.title: Any weather question
phrases: [{x}] (will it|is it going to|going to|chance of|any|expect|expecting) (rain|snow|storm|hail) [{y}]
(is it|will it be|is it going to be) (cold|hot|warm|chilly|cloudy|freezing|nice) [outside|today|tomorrow|tonight] [{y}]
examples: which day will be rainy in this week
is it going to rain tomorrow

commands.title: Date and time
phrases: what is the date and time [now|today]

commands.title: Any traffic question
examples: how is the traffic from home to work

commands.title: Any stock question
phrases: [{x}] (stock|stocks|share price|shares|stock price|stock prices|stock market|stock rate|nasdaq|dow jones) [{y}]
examples: how is coca cola stock doing today

commands.title: Any exchange-rate question
examples: what is the exchange rate between the dollar and the yen

commands.title: Currency against currency
phrases: [{x}] (rupee|rupees|indian rupee|dollar|dollars|us dollar|euro|euros|pound|pounds|yen|inr|usd|u s d|eur|gbp|aud|cad) [going|trading|doing|standing] (against|to|vs|versus|compared to) [the] (rupee|rupees|indian rupee|dollar|dollars|us dollar|euro|euros|pound|pounds|yen|inr|usd|u s d|eur|gbp|aud|cad|a u d|c a d) [{y}]
examples: how much is indian rupee going against us dollar
what is the rate of inr

commands.title: Any definition question
examples: what is the definition of marinara
tell me the brief definition of evacuation

commands.title: Any joke request
examples: hey share me some joke to make me happy

commands.title: Book a ride
commands.say: Opening Uber so you can book the ride.
examples: book a taxi to the airport for tomorrow morning
find me a ride to the mall

commands.title: Ask about alarms
phrases: (did i|have i|have you|is my|are my|do i have|is there|are there) [{y}] (alarm|alarms) [{z}]

commands.title: What's the date
phrases: [{x}] (tell me|let me know|give me|can i have|what is|say) [what] [the] [current|exact] (date|day|today's date|todays date|date and time) [is it|it is] [today|now|for today|please]
(today date|todays date|today's date|date today|current date|the date)

commands.title: What's the time
phrases: [{x}] (tell me|let me know|give me|what is|say) [what] [the] [current|exact] (time|hour) [is it|it is] [now|right now|please]

commands.title: Play something
phrases: [let us|lets|let me|can i|could i|may i] (hear|listen to|put on|play me|throw on|blast|start playing) [some|a|the|my] {q}
examples: i want to hear some jazz
i want to listen to soft rock

commands.title: Radio, podcasts, audiobooks
examples: open harrypotter audiobook and play from last played
start reading that alan partridge book

commands.title: Lower the volume
phrases: (softer|too loud|speak quieter|speak softer|talk quieter|be quieter|lower the sound) [{y}]

commands.title: Raise the volume
phrases: (speak louder|talk louder|cannot hear you|i cannot hear you|too quiet|louder please) [{y}]

commands.title: Mute
examples: mute for the next hour please

commands.title: What's on my lists
phrases: [{x}] (show|read|open|check|see|tell me|what is|what else is|what do i have|what does) [{y}] (list|lists) [{z}]
examples: will you please show me my lists
what is on the list for today

commands.title: Is it on my list?
examples: are eggs on my shopping list

commands.title: Start a list
examples: create a new list for me please

commands.title: Add to my list
examples: add buy groceries to the list

commands.title: Remove from a list
phrases: i do not want this list [any more|anymore]
examples: remove the list of things to do
